maria: Quick check: running tiny-window continuous-batching roast. Need 1) baseline throughput 2) regression check vs yesterday. Can someone run bench with max-batch=16, window-ms=12, max-tokens=512? /cc @kevin @ashok
kevin: on it. Which model and seed? should we use v2-quant or fp16?
maria: v2-int8 if available; fallback to fp16. Use the sample trace id cb-small-3245. Don't change seq-len distribution.

ashok: Sorry ignore the spam, my keyboard stuck.
ashok: i'll queue a loadgen job now. cmd i used: ```./bench/run_cb --model rwl-v2-int8 --concurrency 8 --max-batch 16 --window-ms 12 --max-tokens 512 --trace cb-small-3245```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued bench job #8765 for cb-small-3245. ETA ~8m.
ryan: heads-up: last night we saw a tail-latency bump when window-ms < 15 due to preemption causing KV flushes. Watch eviction_count in perf dashboard.
tess: ping on code review: I left comments on #5122 about adjusting queue-shim backoff. If we change backoff from 5ms->8ms it may reduce jitter.
kevin: bench finished: throughput 1.6k tok/s, p95 latency 78ms, eviction_count spike 120. Saved logs to /runs/8765/results.json. Uploading.
maria: thanks. can you also run same config with max-batch=8 and window-ms=8? need comparison for small-request workloads.
kevin: running now.
ashok: i'll check traces while kevin runs. Quick note: cache hit-rate drops ~3% in int8 path when batch < 10.
kevin: second run done: max-batch=8, window-ms=8 => throughput 1.1k tok/s, p95 62ms, eviction_count 45. Results: /runs/8766/results.json
maria: interesting — lower p95 but less throughput. For production, we should aim for throughput floor >=1.3k tok/s. Can we try adaptive-window heuristic: start window 8ms, grow to 20ms under load?
tess: i can prototype the heuristic. PR will include unit tests and a feature flag. tagging @maria for rollout plan.
maria: cool. Can we schedule a smoke run on staging tomorrow 09:30 PT? Make it run the adaptive config for 30m with traffic profile A.
ryan: works for me. I'll reserve the staging pool and set rollback script. Also add a circuit-breaker threshold for p99 > 300ms.
kevin: created a short summary in the cb-ops doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cb/ops#small-window (links only for the team).
maria: :thumbsup: thx. If anyone sees a regression in embeddings endpoint, tag me. otherwise I'll push the feature-flag PR after tess's prototype.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke run scheduled for 3245087400 (tomorrow 09:30 PT).
